mapper.select: SELECT FROM interview_event e WHERE e.owner_id=#{owner} AND e.id=#{id}

SELECT source_kind,COALESCE(preparation_source_item_id,knowledge_source_item_id) AS source_item_id, COALESCE(preparation_source_version_id,knowledge_source_version_id) AS source_version_id FROM interview_event_material WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND event_id=#{id} AND event_revision=#{revision} ORDER BY ordinal
SELECT snapshot_json FROM interview_event_history WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND event_id=#{id} AND revision=#{revision}
mapper.update: UPDATE interview_event SET target_id=#{event.targetId},target_version_id=#{event.targetVersionId}, title=#{event.title},round_name=#{event.round},location=#{event.location},meeting_url=#{event.meetingUrl}, notes=#{event.notes},local_start=#{event.localStart},zone_id=#{event.zoneId},utc_offset=#{event.offset}, start_at=#{event.startAt},end_at=#{event.endAt},duration_minutes=#{event.durationMinutes}, remind_before_minutes=#{event.remindBeforeMinutes},remind_at=#{event.remindAt}, reminder_acknowledged_at=#{event.reminderAcknowledgedAt},status=#{event.status}, revision=#{event.revision},updated_at=#{event.updatedAt} WHERE owner_id=#{event.ownerId} AND id=#{event.id} AND revision=#{expected} AND status='PLANNED'
